notes.title: Spanish-LATAM available!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Rhea of the Remnant is now available in Spanish (LATAM)![/p][p]Join the adventure and explore the mysteries left behind by the Great War![/p][p]This was achieved in collaboration with Genow, another indie developer who has worked on Bug Fables([url="https://x.com/PaperBugDev"]https://x.com/PaperBugDev[/url]).[/p][p][/p][p]Please let us know your suggestions or opinions in the Steam Discussion Forum!"[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703080/4d37c31aca7e0888b44d69fa1d257a31c22591d3.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703080/a649da30ea1a609574818bdda22ccf87e64e838e.gif"][/img][/p]
